hypothesis: Frozen detector local features provide useful boundary/context evidence that the fixed grayscale descriptors did not capture.
stage: Small-head learnability screen only; not official AP or novelty.
sample: Exactly the same 256 fitting and 128 head-held-out train images, rows and targets as candidate9; never select images using its results.

visual_input.feature: First Detect input, stride8 P3,128 channels; same frozen detector in every arm.
visual_input.preprocessing: Original BGR image, centered 960 square letterbox,color114; RGB/255 FP16. This extraction does not regenerate or modify cached detections.
visual_input.projection: Fixed CPU-seeded Gaussian 128->16, seed20261014, scale1/sqrt128, never fitted to targets.
visual_input.pool: 3x3 samples at fractions0,0.5,1 on each action box, plus 3x3 on its1.25x center expansion; bilinear feature sampling. 288 dimensions.
visual_input.normalization: Fit moments on the selected fitting scenes only.

recipe.selection: Final epoch only; seed1/2 only if seed0 passes. Same initialization and order across four arms per seed.

secondary: Report paired comparisons on geometry-ranking top-two valid utility gap<=0.05, with at least two valid actions. Subset definition is prediction-only and is descriptive, not an alternate gate.
scope: Same weighted sampled fixed-owner ten-threshold/IoU/harm metrics as candidate9, plus existing frozen uniform. No AP/AR claim. Visual ranking versus ordinary visual regression must be reported separately.
limits: Head-held-out scenes were included in historical detector training; this only holds out new-head labels. Equal nominal padded architecture has inactive visual channels in geometry arms. Compression and 8-epoch small-data budget do not test all representations.
budget: 384 single-view frozen detector forwards; no five-view detector replay, detector training or official evaluation. Four small heads at seed0; repeat only after a positive gate. If this representation also fails, stop this local visual-feature screening round rather than tune projection,scale or epochs.
